infobox.usage: Unlocks Leon's hideout on the second floor of a house in the village on Lighthouse.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: The Leon's hideout key (Leon) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the room in the big house next to the bridge that leads to the water treatment plant. Belonged to one of Arena gladiators by the name "Leon".

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text: - Can only be bartered from Ref LL4

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Leon's hideout on the second floor of a house in the village on Lighthouse.
